summary: DevRelay 0.9.0 is an accepted deterministic source/library release, but its packed artifact omits two declared ArchitectureDiscovery exports and the repository is not yet prepared as a public Apache-2.0/DCO open-source preview. V0.10 corrects package completeness, governance, CI support, GitHub release controls, and full Windows Desktop dogfood evidence.
domainConstraints: Generic Core continues to own deterministic lifecycle authority and no release work may introduce product-ID branches.
Every lifecycle artifact and repository input is version-pinned and content-addressed.
GitHub source and an installable release tarball are the only distribution channels for V0.10.
The supported product path is ChatGPT Desktop on Windows; npm publication, hosted services, and one-click plug-in installation are excluded.
The security contact is garrett.audet@gmail.com and main is the protected default branch.
External adapter maturity claims must distinguish contract, fixture, live, and release-ready evidence.
conventions: Use immutable module and adapter versions plus SHA-256-bound artifacts.
Run all applicable released modules in lifecycle order and record explicit not-applicable dispositions for conditional stages.

Use the bounded OpenSpec requirements and design capabilities, native Core dependency analysis, OPA, Graphology-DAG, A2A-aware specialist assignment, local Git integration, and test/review verifiers according to their declared maturity.
Treat the existing uncommitted OSS edits as an unapproved implementation draft until WorkExecution.
Preserve human-readable lifecycle evidence and exact structured artifacts together.
